record.question: Which of the following statements is not correct about ‘Sukanya Samridhi’ scheme?
options:
It is launched by Government of India as a small deposit scheme for the girl child to provide for
          her higher education and marriage.

The account can be opened in the name of a girl child at the time of her birth till she attains the
          age of 10.
The minimum deposit amount is Rs.50/- every year.
A maximum of Rs.1.5 lakh can be deposited in one financial year.
